product.name: Dabba Network
product.description: A decentralized network providing internet connectivity across India through a network of hotspots.

product.name: Dabba Hotspot
product.description: A hardware device that connects to the Dabba Network, requiring an additional fee for activation and assignment to a Local Cable Operator.

product.name: Dabba Pro
product.description: A high-performance router featuring powerful CPU, RAM, and storage, designed for heavy-duty applications and multi-tasking.

product.name: Dabba Explorer
product.description: A platform for managing the deployment and assignment of Dabba Hotspots to Local Cable Operators.

product.name: Dabba App Store
product.description: A platform where developers can create and deploy applications on the Dabba network, leveraging Docker for compatibility and flexibility.

product.name: Dabba Laser
product.description: A core network grid using lasers on rooftops to create a wireless mesh across cities, linking to WiFi routers via cable or 5G.
